captions.detailed: A rugged, documentary-style handheld camcorder colored in matte black. The main body features a blocky rear battery pack, a top carrying handle, and a cylindrical front lens ending in a wide rectangular lens hood. On the right side, a flat viewing screen is mounted on a narrow hinge arm. Articulation includes a continuous rotation joint on the lens control ring, a revolute joint rotating the hinge arm relative to the camera body, and a second revolute joint rotating the viewing screen relative to the hinge arm.

captions.factory: The camcorder is constructed using multiple parts and joints. The main body is formed by unioning a rounded box for the camera housing with a blocky battery box, a top handle structure, and a cylindrical lens base. A separate control ring is created as a cylinder and assigned a continuous joint around the lens barrel axis. The hinge arm is modeled as a small block connected to the body via a revolute joint, and the viewing screen (a thin rectangular plate) is attached to the hinge arm via a second revolute joint.
